## CREEPY, KOOKY, MYSTERIOUS, & SPOOKY HALLOWEEN TREATS TO MAKE YOU DIE


Here comes Halloween! It’s the spookiest time of year, when ghosts, ghouls, gravestones, cobwebs, and pumpkins become lawn decorations and children transform into their favorite characters for a day. But we all know what Halloween is REALLY about: the FOOD!


No matter if you’re hosting a huge party, a Día de los Muertos celebration, or just looking for some Halloween treats, treat yourself to the[best Halloween desserts](https://www.goldbelly.com/holidays/halloween) shipping nationwide! Below are 2026’s standouts across cakes, cookies, cupcakes, donuts, and candy, if you’re looking to take your festivities to the next level this year, these desserts are undeniably BOO-licious.


## **The Best Halloween Desserts**


### **Edgar’s Bakery’s Halloween “Boo” Cake**


Edgar’s Bakery is one of Alabama’s most beloved homespun bakeries, with nearly a dozen locations throughout the state. This Halloween cake is covered in spooky-silly ghosts, bats, and more, and inside the green frosting if your choice of chocolate, vanilla, or strawberry cake.


**[Halloween “Boo” Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/edgars-bakery/boo-cake)**


### **** **Brownie Points’ “Spooky Eyes” Brownie Bruffles**


Brownie Points has been baking up the fudgiest, most chocolatey brownies on earth since Lisa King founded the business in Columbus, Ohio, in 1991, and her “Bruffles” – fudgy Brownies rolled with ganache and cream cheese and wrapped in a rich chocolate shell – have become her hallmark. These are decorated to look like creepy eyeballs!


**[“Spooky Eyes” Brownie Bruffles >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/brownie-points/halloween-spooky-eyes-brownie-bruffles)**


### **Duff Goldman’s Peanut Butter Jack-O-Lantern Cake**


A classic jack-o’-lantern cake is guaranteed to be a showstopping party centerpiece! This Chocolate Peanut Butter Jack-O-Lantern Cake **** from the Ace of Cakes himself, Duff Goldman, is a chocolate cake layered with caramel cream cheese and decorated with orange frosting, a black fondant jack-o-lantern face, a green buttercream stem, and sprinkles!


**[Chocolate Peanut Butter Jack-O-Lantern Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman/peanut-butter-jack-o-lantern-cake)**


**Baked in Color’s Halloween Oreo Brownies & Cookies**


Orange brownies and cookies are a no-brainer, and this Halloween Oreo Brownie & Cookie Combo are loaded with Oreo cookies! The accompanying orange & black cookies are soft, gooey, and loaded with chocolate chips.


[Halloween Oreo Brownie & Cookie Combo Pack >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/baked-in-color/halloween-oreo-brownie-cookie-combo-16-pack)


### **Elle’s Belles Bakery’s Sugar Skull Cake With Flower Crown**


This just might be the most ornate cake you’ll see all year! Made by Elle’s Belles Bakery for Dia De Los Muertos, this hand-painted Sugar Skull Cake With a Flower Crown isn’t just pretty to look at – there’s also a delicious chocolate cake inside.


[Dia De Las Muertas Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/elles-belles/sugar-skull-cake-with-flower-crown)


### **East Side Cheesecakes’s “My Little Boo Thang” Halloween Cheesecake**


East Side Cheesecakes is proving that there’s really a cheesecake for every occasion! Their “My Little Boo Thang” Halloween Cheesecake has everything to celebrate the season – a thick Oreo crust and a pumpkin orange center loaded with Oreo pieces, and it’s topped with a dark chocolate ganache, spooky sprinkles, and buttercream ghosts!


[“My Little Boo Thang” Halloween Cheesecake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/east-side-cheesecakes/my-little-boo-thang-halloween-cheesecake)


### **Elegant Desserts’ Iced Halloween Sugar Cookies**


You can spend all day whipping up a variety of treats, or you can order this impressive array of Iced Halloween Sugar Cookies from Elegant Desserts! These buttery cookies are handmade with plenty of detail, and are all dressed up as pumpkins and bats.


[Iced Halloween Sugar Cookies >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/elegant-desserts-ny/iced-halloween-sugar-cookies-12-pack)


### **Angel Food Bakery’s Halloween Message Donuts**


Say it with doughnuts! Lay out a centerpiece of freshly fried yeast-raised Halloween Message Donuts, creatively frosted with Halloween-themed decorations and spelling out either LET’S GET SPOOKY or HAPPY HALLOWEEN. These just might be too pretty to eat! (Might be!)


[Halloween Message Donuts >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/angel-food-bakery-and-donut-bar/halloween-message-donuts)


### **The Goddess & Grocer’s Halloween Cookie Decorating Kit**


This Halloween Cookie Decorating Kit might just be the perfect Halloween DIY project for kids! Get creative and top these cookies with icing and sprinkles, then eat your edible works of art!


[Halloween Cookie Decorating Kit >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants//the-goddess-and-grocer/halloween-cookie-decorating-kit)


### **Flour Shop’s Halloween Rainbow Explosion Cake**


New York’s Flour Shop has become renowned for its famous Explosion Cakes, which are filled with candy, sprinkles, and other goodies that “explode” out of the center of the cake when it’s sliced., Just for Halloween, this colorful Rainbow Explosion Cake is all dressed up like a jack-o’-lantern, topped with Halloween candy, and filled with goodies.


[Halloween Vanilla Rainbow Explosion Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/flour-shop/halloween-vanilla-rainbow-explosion-cake)


### **Sugarfina’s “For Your Boos” Halloween Candy Bundle**


This definitely isn’t your standard Halloween candy! Sugarfina is renowned for its custom candy creations, and for Halloween they’ve created a Black Cat Candy Bento Box, filled with Sparkle Pops, Spooky Ghosts, Skeleton Sugar Skulls, Pumpkin Caramel Crunchies, and Zombie Brains.


[“For Your Boos” Halloween Candy Bundle >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/sugarfina/for-your-boos-candy-bundle-5-pack)


### **Erin McKenna’s Bakery’s Vegan + Gluten Free Halloween Cupcakes**


Vegan? Gluten-free? Not to worry! One of the most magical things about cupcakes is that they can be adapted for just about any dietary restriction (or holiday) you can think of. These Vegan Halloween Cupcakes aren’t just beautifully decorated, they’re also completely vegan and gluten free!)


[Vegan and Gluten Free Halloween Cupcakes >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/erin-mckennas-bakery/halloween-cupcakes)


### **Treat House’s Halloween Rice Krispie Treats**


Take a bite out of Halloween with Treat House’s Halloween Rice Krispie Treats. From purple bats to mini Frankenstein heads to mummies, each tiny treat features a mini design that is big on taste and spirit.


[Halloween Rice Krispie Treats Deluxe Gift Box >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/treat-house/halloween-rice-krispie-treats-gift-box)

## **Halloween Desserts FAQs**


**What are the best Halloween desserts to order online?**


Standouts for 2026 include decorated Halloween cakes (like jack-o’-lantern and sugar skull designs), Oreo brownie and cookie combos, Halloween candy cheesecake, iced sugar cookies, and themed cupcakes, all available shipped nationwide.


**What’s a good centerpiece dessert for a Halloween party?**


A decorated Halloween cake is the classic party centerpiece — think jack-o’-lantern cakes, “explosion” cakes filled with candy, or an ornate sugar skull cake for a Día de los Muertos-inspired spread.


**Are there vegan or gluten-free Halloween dessert options?**


Yes, several bakeries make dedicated vegan and gluten-free Halloween treats, including fully vegan and gluten-free decorated cupcakes.

Yes. Goldbelly ships Halloween cakes, cookies, cupcakes, donuts, cheesecake, and candy nationwide from bakeries across the U.S., timed to arrive in time for the holiday.
